619685.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 3]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's 5000 DP or lower Digimon. Then, for every 2 colors your Tamers have, return 1 of their suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains [Alliance] for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
619685.Inherited Effect: [Alliance] (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains [Security A. +1] and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

[Main] [Delay] (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect.)
• Gain 2 memory.
621145.Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
